title: 第2109章 剑雪灭万兽剑浪镇三妖第2108章 积攒的愤怒剑雪飘大荒
content_zh:
“是谁？？胆敢残杀万妖城，给我出来！！”
暴戾的声音从万妖城内传出，巨大的妖影遁冲出万妖城的结界，还没感应到顾余生的气息，就被一道从雪花中凝出的沛然剑气化作一团血雾，妖婴仓惶遁出，又被杀戮剑意直接抹杀。
大妖之血泼洒万妖城，瞬间刺激其他大妖的凶性，他们在第一时间并未感觉到畏惧，只是觉得他们的地盘被入侵了，积攒的愤怒使得他们显出原形，想要凭借强大的妖身震慑来敌。
百丈高的巨狮，夔马，数千丈长的蟒蛇影耀长空，它们自大地认为垂落的区区雪花，根本无法伤他们的本体分毫，一开始飘落的雪剑也的确之发出铮铮铮的敲铁之声。
当他们气势汹汹地冲进剑光圣耀的核心区域时，一开始无法击穿他们强大妖身的雪剑，威力急剧增强数十倍，上千倍，万倍，每一片垂落的雪花，都会在他们身上飞溅起鲜血。
从一开始的不痒不痛，到躯体被锐利的剑花刮出鲜血，待到剧痛之时想要防御，这些大妖惊恐地发现，它们引以为傲的妖身，在雪花剑气里早已无法自我愈合。
暗藏了荒气的雪花剑气，使得腾空的大妖无法在变小恢复人身，当雪花之中夹杂着百余道剑气狠狠斩落时，他们庞大的躯体成了活靶子，狮头，夔角从高空坠落，他们修行千年岁月积攒在体内的能量肆意爆开，整个万妖城一片寂灭灰暗。
这时，妖皇级别的妖修终于意识到不对，来人不是来耀武，而是要将他们所有妖族抹杀。
“人族来犯，人族来犯！！”
万妖城内，古老的人皮鼓被熊妖敲响，咚咚咚的敲击声夹杂着妖圣以上的意志，使得互相厮杀的万妖各自罢斗，他们回寰入城，方见整座万妖城内，由一开始的人族鲜血染地，变成了妖尸遍地。
这短短的两炷香时间，万妖城内死去的妖族，已经比人族凡人还要多了。
“大胆狂修，你要挑起两族战争吗！”
万妖城内，三名气息庞大的妖修同时遁出，他们身上没有妖祖的敕封之力，但实力已经不在大荒十大妖圣之下，粗犷的外表下，妖气凝于体，小玄界的法则与他们的身体激荡，呈现奇特的涟漪。说明他们并非大荒的妖修，而是来自妖界的强者。
这三名实力强大的妖修，赫然都是来自于剑虎族，他们脸上的面纹，宛若一把把锯齿剑，每一位都有合体境中后期的实力。
三大妖修一出现，同时将身上的剑纹解封，一道道旋转的锯齿剑逆冲而起，试图抗衡顾余生的剑意，但顾余生剑势如云，垂落的雪花无处不在，三大妖修虽能阻挡一时，却不能一直持续。
“人族剑修？杀了他！”
三名妖修对视一眼，放弃了阻止天上坠落剑气的想法，他们保持人形，躯体膨胀三分，化作近涨高大的人形，以虎爪驭面纹之剑，以妖血催动的剑纹立刻具象化，十八道妖剑风驰电掣切斩向顾余生。
顾余生单手托剑，脚下剑莲旋转，保持天象剑阵持续运转，其身一动，掌心凝出一剑，一记平平无奇的横斩，一道金色剑气迎上十八道强大的妖剑切斩。
剑气触碰的刹那，天地失音，万妖城千丈城阙上隔着数丈的妖石像削首飞空，城墙被剑气切开一道泄光的裂隙，又迅速地弥合在一起。
顾余生的身后，十八道妖剑之气斩断数座山峰。

这一对比之下，好似顾余生落入下风，三名强大的妖修神色一喜，傲然跃空，他们面上的妖纹再一次化作更加锐利的剑气，这一次，他们将六道剑气化一，三道剑气再并一，对着顾余生所在，当空狠狠切斩下来。
天地猝然一暗，妖族修士施展的御剑之术，本质是对妖力的具象化，倚靠血脉凝出超凡的力量和对自然风雷火的驾驭，他们看出顾余生神识化天地之雪，无法御飞剑对抗，故而想要以雷霆手段诛灭顾余生。
剑虎族作为妖界巨力一类灵妖，极难开智化形，可一旦开智化形，他们的实力还会得到成倍的提升，他们以三敌一，占据境界上的小层次优势，又在顾余生神识分化之时合力全击，这一剑的威能，足以毁天灭地。
骤暗的世界一隙明亮，澎湃的妖力斩过天空，顾余生自脚之后，裂开一条长达百余里的裂隙，顾余生站在剑光之柱下，如同一粒黑点。
可就是这么小小的奇点，不急不慢地从匣内拔出最后一把剑，右手持剑柄往天空一顶，剑尖爆发出的剑气被合妖剑气压成透明伞状。
咫尺天地，却生生扛住了天空落下的巨大剑气，恐怖的剑气灵光向四面八方激荡，席卷千尺雪浪，蔓延至深山凡人避难之地。
少年本无挂碍，在这生死之间，他内心的悲天悯人并未被危机所泯，他缓缓合上眼，塌陷的双脚向中并拢，弥漫向外的剑气如同回风迎浪倒袭而来，两面剑墙高万丈。
从高处看去，少年如站在沧溟深水的裂隙之中，他大喝一声，将所有的剑浪全部旋集于身体周围，一朵巨大的剑浪逆旋起来。
轰！
剑浪冲过云层，天地间的雪花戛然而止，天象剑阵被破，倾落的雪花停止，雪花落下来，本来还可以斩杀更多的妖兽，可是也会波及到凡人。
当所有的剑浪被旋转的剑莲抵消，少年的身影重新出现在万妖城前，剑气侵破衣衫，片片缕缕，剑气刺破肉身，鲜血淋淋，但他的目光是如此的坚定，嘴角更像是在嘲笑三大妖修的无能。
“什么？！”
原本以为胜券在握的三大剑虎妖修，表情陡然僵住，余光过处，它们身后的城阙整齐地坍塌，没有伤及城内任何凡人，逸散天地间的剑气，被他以两只脚控制在方圆数丈范围。
少年身上的伤，不是他们造成的，而少年那坚定的眼神，更让他们遍体生寒。
人族什么时候出了这么个怪物。
沙！
沙！
沙！
少年的步履践过飞扬的雪花，一步步欺近，他手中握着的剑，将天地间所有的灵气一瞬榨干，甚至将所有死掉的妖族气血全部吸于剑身。
“你究竟是谁？”

“等一下！！”
“你若再往前一步，我们会将城内所有的人族杀死！！”
嗡！
一声剑响，少年的身影在雪地里留下一道道残影，只听得噗的一声，他手上的剑以江湖剑客的招式，以手握着狠狠贯穿最后一位说话的妖修，少年头发随风飘荡，微抬起的头露出一双冰冷的眼眸：“你大可以试试看……”
content_en:
"Who is it?? Dare to kill Ten Thousand Monsters City, come out!!"
Violent sounds came from the Ten Thousand Demon City, and the huge demon shadow rushed out of the barrier of the Ten Thousand Demon City. Before it could sense Gu Yusheng's aura, it was transformed into a ball of blood mist by the Peiran sword energy condensed from the snowflakes. The demon baby escaped in panic, and was directly obliterated by the killing sword intent.
The blood of the great demon spilled into the City of Ten Thousand Demons, instantly stimulating the ferocity of the other great demons. They did not feel fear at the first moment, but felt that their territory had been invaded. The accumulated anger made them reveal their true colors, hoping to frighten the enemy with their powerful demon bodies.
Giant lions that are hundreds of feet tall, Kui horses, and pythons that are thousands of feet long shine in the sky. They arrogantly believe that the falling snowflakes cannot hurt their bodies at all. The snow swords that fell at the beginning did indeed make a clanging sound.
When they rushed into the core area of ​​Sword Light Shengyao, the power of the snow sword, which was unable to penetrate their powerful demon body at first, increased sharply by dozens, thousands, or ten thousand times. Every falling snowflake would splash blood on their bodies.
From the beginning there was no itching or pain, to the sharp sword flowers scraping blood from their bodies, and when they tried to defend themselves from the severe pain, these big demons were horrified to find that their proud demon bodies could no longer heal themselves in the Snow Flower Sword Qi.
The snowflake sword energy that concealed desolate energy made it impossible for the big monsters in the air to shrink back and restore their bodies. When the snowflakes mixed with more than a hundred sword energy slashed down, their huge bodies became living targets. The lion heads and Kui horns fell from the sky. The energy they had accumulated in their bodies for thousands of years exploded wantonly, and the entire City of Ten Thousand Monsters was filled with silence and darkness.
At this time, the demon cultivators at the demon king level finally realized that something was wrong. The people who came were not here to show off their power, but to wipe out all their demon clans.
"The human race is invading, the human race is invading!!"
In the City of Ten Thousand Demons, the ancient human skin drum was beaten by the bear demon. The thumping sound was mixed with the will of the Demon Saint and above, causing the ten thousand demons who were fighting each other to stop fighting. They returned to Huan and entered the city. Only then did they see that the entire Ten Thousand Demon City was stained with human blood at the beginning, but became full of demon corpses.
In the short period of two sticks of incense, more demons died in the City of Ten Thousand Demons than the mortals of the human race.
"Bold Kuang Xiu, are you going to start a war between the two races?"
Within the City of Ten Thousand Demons, three demon cultivators with huge auras escaped at the same time. They did not have the power of the Demon Ancestor's seal, but their strength was no longer inferior to the ten demon saints of the Great Wilderness. Under their rough appearance, the demon aura condensed into their bodies, and the laws of the Mysterious Small World stirred up with their bodies, creating strange ripples. It shows that they are not demon cultivators from the wilderness, but strong men from the demon world.
These three powerful demon cultivators are all from the Sword Tiger Clan. The facial patterns on their faces are like serrated swords. Each one of them has the strength of the middle and late stages of the Fusion Realm.
As soon as the three demon cultivators appeared, they unsealed the sword patterns on their bodies at the same time. The rotating serrated swords rose up one after another, trying to counter Gu Yusheng's sword intent. However, Gu Yusheng's sword was as powerful as a cloud, and falling snowflakes were everywhere. Although the three demon cultivators could block it for a while, they could not last forever.
"Human swordsman? Kill him!"
The three demon cultivators looked at each other and gave up the idea of preventing the sword energy from falling from the sky. They maintained their human form, expanded their bodies by three thirds, and transformed into a nearly tall human form. They controlled the sword with facial patterns with tiger claws. The sword patterns activated by demon blood immediately materialized, and eighteen demon swords struck Gu Yusheng with lightning speed.
Gu Yusheng held the sword with one hand and rotated the sword lotus under his feet to keep the celestial sword array in continuous operation. With a movement of his body, a sword condensed from his palm, an ordinary horizontal slash, and a golden sword energy met eighteen powerful demon sword cuts.
The moment the sword energy came into contact, the heaven and earth lost all sound. The monster stone statues separated by several feet from the Thousand Demon City's city walls were cut off and flew into the air. The sword energy cut a crack in the city wall that let out light, and then quickly closed together.
Behind Gu Yusheng, the energy of eighteen demonic swords cut through several mountain peaks.
this pairIn comparison, as if Gu Yusheng was at a disadvantage, the three powerful demon cultivators looked happy and jumped into the air proudly. The demon marks on their faces once again turned into sharper sword energy. This time, they turned the six sword energies into one, and the three sword energies merged into one, and they slashed at Gu Yusheng's position in the air.
The world suddenly darkened. The sword control skills performed by the demon monks were essentially the embodiment of demon power. They relied on their blood to condense extraordinary strength and control the natural wind, thunder and fire. They saw that Gu Yusheng's consciousness had transformed into the snow of heaven and earth and could not control the flying swords to resist, so they wanted to kill Gu Yusheng with thunder.
As the most powerful spirit demons in the demon world, the Sword Tiger Clan is extremely difficult to transform. However, once they transform, their strength will be doubled. With three enemies to one, they occupy a small level advantage in the realm. When Gu Yusheng's consciousness is divided, they attack with all their strength. The power of this sword is enough to destroy the world.
The suddenly dark world suddenly became bright, and the surging demonic power slashed across the sky. A crack of more than a hundred miles long opened behind Gu Yusheng's feet. Gu Yusheng stood under the pillar of sword light, like a black dot.
But it was such a small singularity. He unhurriedly pulled out the last sword from the box, held the hilt in his right hand and raised it to the sky. The sword energy erupting from the tip of the sword was compressed into a transparent umbrella shape by the combined demon sword energy.
The world is so close, but it can withstand the huge sword energy falling from the sky. The terrifying sword energy aura surges in all directions, sweeps thousands of feet of snow waves, and spreads to the refuge of mortals in the mountains.
The young man had no worries at all. In this life-and-death situation, the compassion in his heart was not wiped out by the crisis. He slowly closed his eyes, his collapsed feet moved closer together, and the sword energy that filled the outward direction was like a returning wind and a wave, and the two sword walls were high.
Seen from a high place, the young man seemed to be standing in a crack in the deep water. He shouted loudly and gathered all the sword waves around his body, and a huge sword wave began to spin in reverse.
boom!
The sword wave rushed through the clouds, and the snowflakes between the sky and the earth stopped abruptly. The celestial sword formation was broken, and the falling snowflakes stopped. The snowflakes fell, and could have killed more monsters, but they would also affect mortals.
When all the sword waves were offset by the rotating sword lotus, the young man's figure reappeared in front of the Ten Thousand Demons City. The sword energy penetrated his clothes, and the sword energy pierced his flesh and blood dripped. But his eyes were so firm, and the corner of his mouth seemed to be mocking the incompetence of the three demon cultivators.
"What?!"
The expressions of the three sword tiger demon cultivators who originally thought they were sure of victory suddenly froze. From the corner of his eye, he saw that the city behind them collapsed neatly, without hurting any mortals in the city. The sword energy that escaped between heaven and earth was controlled by him within a few feet in radius with his two feet.
The injuries on the young man's body were not caused by them, and the young man's firm eyes made them feel cold all over.
When did such a monster appear in the human race?
sand!
sand!
sand!
The young man's steps trampled through the flying snowflakes, approaching step by step. The sword he held in his hand drained all the spiritual energy in the world in an instant, and even sucked all the blood of the dead monsters into the sword.
"Who are you anyway?"
"Wait a minute!!"
"If you take one step forward, we will kill all the humans in the city!!"
Buzz!
There was a sound of the sword, and the young man's figure left a trail of afterimages in the snow. There was only a pop. The sword in his hand used the moves of a swordsman in the world to pierce through the last demon cultivator who spoke. The young man's hair was blowing in the wind, and he raised his head slightly to reveal a pair of cold eyes: "You can give it a try..."
